title: Atlanta's Shopping Heaven Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum of 2 guests per booking is required.
policies: Minimum numbers of (4) guest to run tour. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there are not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund.
Additional charges may apply for hotel pickup outside of selected locations.
Tour start time/duration starts at the time of pick up.
Tour start time is approximate and can be adjusted for traffic conditions and pick-up schedule
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Calling all fashionistas! Tour two of Atlanta's premier shopping destinations on this small group tour. Get ready for an unparalleled shopping experience, first visiting Lenox Mall and then Phipps Plaza. Roundtrip transportation is included from downtown Atlanta, Midtown and Buckhead.

Since 1959, Lenox Square® has been the premier shopping destination for fashionistas throughout the Southeast. Located in the heart of Buckhead, Lenox Square offers an unparalleled shopping and dinning experience. This mall is the local hotspot to see and be seen, maybe take glimpse at a local celebrity.
